name: i-ran-pilot
style: Grade: moody anamorphic 35mm night cinematography with readable exposure, dark emerald and teal shadows, a warm orange firelight key on faces, thin green lasers cutting through haze, deep but not crushed blacks, rim light, subtle film grain, oval bokeh. High-end music video still, sharp focus on the subject, correct human anatomy and natural proportions, two arms and two hands per person, realistic hands.

rafa.name: Rafa
rafa.identity: Keep exactly his face, bone structure, dark eyes, thick curly black hair, thin moustache and goatee, diamond stud earrings, warm olive-tan skin (the same tone on face, arms and legs) and lean athletic build.
rafa.look: Earthy jungle-festival utility set: an unbuttoned short-sleeve camp shirt worn open over his bare chest with a black tactical nylon chest harness with grey buckles strapped over his bare torso, and matching relaxed knee-length cargo shorts with plain flat flap side pockets, both cut from the same washed olive-khaki cotton ripstop fabric; a faded grey paisley bandana knotted loosely around his neck; his thin gold chain with a small cross pendant plus a short cord necklace of dark wooden beads; stacked chunky silver chain bracelets on both wrists; and on his feet only, scuffed tan suede lace-up boots with grey socks.

lune.name: Lune
lune.identity: Keep exactly her face, features, full lips, brown eyes, freckles and long wavy chestnut-brown hair; a slim confident woman in her mid twenties with sun-warm skin.
lune.look: Earthy-futurist jungle-festival outfit: a strappy brushed-silver metallic halter harness bikini top; low-slung distressed washed-olive denim micro shorts with frayed hems; a thin beaded waist chain; stacked silver chain bracelets and a twisted barbed-wire-style silver cuff climbing her left forearm; a wide metallic silver fabric headwrap tied across her forehead with a few small yellow flowers tucked into her hair; small silver hoops; and on her feet only, short scuffed tan suede lace-up ankle boots.

canopy_floor.prompt: a packed night-time jungle rave rendered as soft out-of-focus bokeh behind the subject: blurred silhouetted dancers, glowing teal stage lights, green laser haze and warm bulb strings through palm fronds.

fire_path.prompt: a wooden rope bridge through dark jungle, softly defocused, small torch flames and warm bokeh along the ropes, teal haze beyond.

lagoon_edge.prompt: the dark edge of a jungle lagoon, softly defocused, orange fire reflections rippling on black water, big leaves in the near foreground, pale moonlit mist far behind.

shots.still: A sea of silhouetted dancers with raised hands under fanning green lasers, a glowing geodesic stage and sci-fi towers far behind the palms, full moon in haze.
shots.motion: The crowd bounces to the beat, lasers sweep left to right.
shots.camera: Slow push forward through the foliage.
shots.framing: Wide establishing shot, 24mm lens, deep atmospheric haze, no main characters.

shots.still: Medium shot of Rafa standing still in the middle of the dancing crowd, lit from the side by an orange flare, looking off to the right.
shots.motion: Dancers blur past around him while he stays still and scans the crowd.
shots.camera: Slow orbit to the left around him.
shots.framing: Medium shot from the waist up, 85mm lens at f/1.4, subject sharp, background heavily defocused.

shots.still: Medium close-up of Lune dancing with her eyes closed, green laser light across her face, mist behind her.
shots.motion: She sways and tosses her hair back, sequins flashing.
shots.framing: Medium close-up from the chest up, 85mm lens at f/1.4, subject sharp, background heavily defocused.

shots.still: Close-up of Rafa's face in teal light as he notices someone, crowd bokeh behind him.
shots.motion: His gaze locks on and a slight smile forms.
shots.framing: Close-up of the face and shoulders, 100mm lens at f/1.4, background melted into bokeh.

shots.still: Close-up of Lune opening her eyes and looking straight past the camera, orange rim light on her hair.
shots.motion: She opens her eyes, meets his gaze, then smirks and turns away.
shots.framing: Close-up of the face and shoulders, 100mm lens at f/1.4, background melted into bokeh.

shots.still: Lune seen from behind slipping away between dancers toward the dark tree line, looking back over her shoulder.
shots.motion: She weaves quickly through the crowd and glances back once.
shots.camera: Follows behind her at shoulder height.
shots.framing: Medium shot from behind over her shoulder as she looks back, 85mm at f/1.4, background heavily defocused.

shots.still: Rafa pushing through the packed crowd, lasers overhead, focused expression.
shots.motion: He shoulders between dancers moving toward camera.
shots.camera: Backward tracking shot in front of him.
shots.framing: Medium shot from the waist up, 85mm lens at f/1.4, subject sharp, background heavily defocused.

shots.still: Lune running down the torch-lit rope bridge, hair flying.
shots.motion: She runs away from camera deeper into the path, torches flicker.
shots.framing: Medium shot tracking beside her as she runs, 50mm at f/1.8, motion-blurred defocused background.

shots.still: Rafa running down the torch-lit path, the bridge swaying under his boots.
shots.motion: He runs toward camera, breathing hard.
shots.camera: Fast backward track, slight handheld shake.
shots.framing: Medium shot of him running toward camera, 50mm at f/1.8, motion-blurred defocused background.

shots.still: Insert shot of torch flames and sparks rising into the canopy, green laser slicing the mist above.
shots.motion: Sparks spiral upward, the laser flickers to the beat.
shots.framing: Extreme close-up insert of torch flames and sparks, 100mm macro, no people.

shots.still: Lune stopping at the lagoon edge, catching her breath, fire reflections on the water behind her.
shots.motion: She slows, turns around and waits, chest rising.
shots.camera: Slow dolly toward her across the water's edge.
shots.framing: Medium close-up from the chest up, 85mm lens at f/1.4, subject sharp, background heavily defocused.

shots.still: Rafa stepping out from between giant leaves onto the lagoon edge, orange glow on his face.
shots.motion: He pushes the leaves aside and steps forward, slowing down.
shots.framing: Medium shot from the waist up, 85mm lens at f/1.4, subject sharp, background heavily defocused.

shots.still: Two-shot of Rafa and Lune facing each other a step apart at the lagoon edge, moon and mist behind.
shots.motion: They close the distance slowly, eyes locked.
shots.framing: Medium two-shot from the waist up, 50mm lens at f/1.8, both faces sharp, background heavily defocused.

shots.still: Close two-shot of Rafa and Lune dancing close together, her hand on his chest, teal and orange light mixing on their faces.
shots.motion: They sway together to the beat, foreheads nearly touching.
shots.framing: Intimate close two-shot, 85mm at f/1.4, faces close together, background melted into bokeh.

shots.still: High angle over the whole jungle rave, lasers bursting from the stage over the crowd, fire bowls glowing among palms.
shots.motion: The crowd jumps as the lasers burst outward.
shots.framing: Wide establishing shot, 24mm lens, deep atmospheric haze, no main characters.

shots.still: Close-up of Rafa and Lune kissing framed by dark palm leaves in the foreground, orange rim light, mist.
shots.motion: They kiss slowly; the leaves sway in front of them.
shots.camera: Very slow push through the leaves.
shots.framing: Intimate close-up of the kiss, 100mm at f/1.4, dark leaves soft in the foreground, background melted into bokeh.

sheet.front: Character reference panel: one full-body front view, head to toe with both feet fully visible and space above the head, standing straight and relaxed, arms at the sides, facing the camera. Seamless flat light grey studio background, soft even diffused light, photoreal, natural skin texture with a light sheen of sweat, sharp focus, no text, no labels, no other people.
sheet.back: Character reference panel: one full-body BACK view. The person faces directly away from the camera: we see the back of the head, the hair from behind, the shoulder blades, the back of the outfit, the backs of the legs and the heels. The face is not visible at all. Head to toe with both feet fully visible, arms relaxed at the sides. Seamless flat light grey studio background, soft even diffused light, photoreal, natural skin texture with a light sheen of sweat, sharp focus, no text, no labels, no other people.
sheet.side: Character reference panel: one full-body SIDE profile view. The person is turned a strict 90 degrees to the right: only the right side of the body and one eye are visible, nose pointing to the right edge of the frame, like a passport profile. Head to toe with both feet fully visible, arms relaxed at the sides. Seamless flat light grey studio background, soft even diffused light, photoreal, natural skin texture with a light sheen of sweat, sharp focus, no text, no labels, no other people.
sheet.anchor: Three-quarter-length fashion reference photo from the top of the head to mid-thigh, standing straight facing the camera, arms relaxed, the whole outfit clearly visible. Seamless flat light grey studio background, soft even diffused light, photoreal, natural skin texture with a light sheen of sweat, sharp focus, no text, no labels, no other people.
sheet.closeup: Character reference panel: an extreme close-up portrait of the face and shoulders only. The head fills the upper two thirds of the frame; the crop ends at the upper chest. Facing the camera directly, neutral expression. Do not show the waist, legs or feet. Seamless flat light grey studio background, soft even diffused light, photoreal, natural skin texture with a light sheen of sweat, sharp focus, no text, no labels, no other people.

keyframe_rules: Use the reference images only for each person's identity and wardrobe: do not copy their pose, framing, lighting or grey background. Relight them with the scene: warm firelight on the face, teal and green laser spill on skin, sweat glistening. Natural candid mid-action body language, never posing for the camera.
